chunks: ʿAlī narrated from his father, from al-Nawfalī, from al-Sukūnī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Indeed, Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام crucified a man in al-Ḥīrah for three days, then brought him down on the fourth day, performed salat over him, and buried him.

key_terms.أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amīr al-Muʾminīn, the title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.الْحِيرَةِ: al-Ḥīrah, the location where the event occurred
key_terms.وَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ: and he performed funeral salat over him

ai.seo_question: Did Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī عليه السلام have a crucified person taken down and buried after three days?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī عليه السلام crucified a man in al-Ḥīrah for three days, then had him taken down on the fourth day and conducted his burial rites. The report is relevant to legal discussions on punishments and indicates that even after such a penalty, the deceased was given salat and burial.
